main_text.l: din Mohammed Ebn Ahmed AlMahalli, qui partem
Alkorani brevibus Scholiis explicavit; alter جلال الدين عبد
الرحمن الاسيوطي Ialaloddin Abdor' Rah-
man AlOsjuti, qui mortuo primo, reliquum absolvit
anno H. 871. natus, ut ipse in historia sua testatur,
anno H. 849. Idem (ut videtur) qui libri Mezhar
jam memorati author; perinde est enim sive Assoyuti,
sive AlOsjuti dicas, cum loci seu pagi Ægyptiaci
nomen, unde haec appellatio, utroque modo scriba
tur, teste AlFiruzab. scil. سيوط Soyut, & اسيوط Osyut.
AlCeshaf ] الكشاف Commentarius in Alc. au-
thore AlZamachshario, scil. ابو القاسم محمود بن عمر بن محمد
الخوارزمي الزمخشري Abulkasem Mahmud Ebn Omar Ebn Mohammed AlChowarazmi
AlZamachshari. natus est in Zamachshar Chowaraz-
mi oppido, anno H. 467. mortuus ann. 538. Ebn Chalec.
AlBidawius ] seu AlBaidawi. scil. ناصر الدين ابو الخير
عبد الله بن عمر البيضاوي Naseroddin Abdol'lahi Ebn
Omar, &c. AlBaidawi, celebris in Alc. commentarii
author, nec non libri Scholastici de fundamentis
religionis الطوالع dicti &c. obiit anno H. 692. Epit. Tafei.
AlMidani ] seu Midanensis, vel Maidanensis,
utroque enim modo scribitur, teste AlFiruz: ابو الفضل احمد بن
محمد الميداني النيسابوري AbulPhadli
Ahmed Ebn Mohammed AlMaidani AlNaisaburi, à
ميدان Maidan, sc. vico quodam in نيسابور Naisa-
bur denominatus. obiit anno H. 518.

page.notes: Page starts mid-word ("din"), a continuation from the previous page; Arabic is copied as printed. Right margin note "p. 69." is placed beside the Almidani paragraph. The Arabic line "جلال الدين..." is reproduced from the scan; individual Arabic letters are uncertain in places and were not verified letter by letter. No running head is printed on this page.
